title: the player 2 window follows the last input device too
why: His order (2026-10-18): "player should get key prompts if that is the last input they used -- xbox controller prompts should only pop up if player is actively using the controller -- e.g. real time glyph switching", and "2P demo: P1 on keyboard and mouse sees key prompts, P2 on a pad sees pad prompts, each window switches on its own". The tracker of v30.66 treated the player 2 window as having no keyboard (it handed every key to player 1) and kept the pad prompts there. Since v30.68 (cw-p2keys: keys control whatever screen is to the top) the player 2 window plays its own keys, so a key press there left the pad prompts up. Every window is judged the same now; a mouse move counts only in the window that has the keyboard so the host pointer crossing the other window changes nothing there.
now: The second player window now follows what it used last too: a key shows keys, its controller shows its buttons.
